prBodyNotes: After the merge: the image `ghcr.io/42bitgmbh/freeradius-exporter:<new version>` exists, bump it in `scep-gateway/compose.yaml` of the compose repo.

packageRules.description: Go base image of the build stage: a merge rebuilds and moves the tag of the current exporter version
